summary: Pittsburgh resident, parent of young children, software engineer with a focus on programming languages (especially Lisp and Clojure), strong interest in artificial intelligence and machine learning, critical of corporate practices and income inequality, advocates for ethical considerations in technology, engaged in discussions about education and parenting, values community and cultural institutions, skeptical of mainstream media narratives, interested in the intersection of technology and society, has a background in computer science and philosophy, follows developments in tech startups and programming languages, expresses concern over economic disparities and the future of work.
